__broaden__.a: a — to, at · also aver — he/she has (3rd sg. present, h-less spelling of ha, as in el rey me a ayrado = el rey me ha airado)
__broaden__.e: e — and (= modern y) · also aver — I have (1st sg. present, apocopated form of he, perfect auxiliary: Espeso e el oro, 'I have spent the gold')
__broaden__.conpra: conpra — buying, purchase (= compra) · also comprar — he/she buys (present 3rd sg.; = compra), as in non lo conpra, 'he does not buy it'
__broaden__.grado: grado — thanks (grado a … 'thanks be to …') · also grado — will, good will (de grado 'willingly, gladly'; de grado non avrié nada, 'of good will there would be nothing to be had')
__broaden__.i: e/i — and (variant of e before some sounds) · also i — ibi — there, therein (adverb, Latin ibi, like French y; meted i las fedes, 'put your pledged faith into it')
__broaden__.qué: qué — what a …! (exclamative) · also qué — what? which? (interrogative pronoun/adjective, as in de qué será pagado, 'with what will he be satisfied')
__broaden__.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year')
